notes.content:
✨ NEW
(Music) Menu: "Cytokinesis" by 4NoteClover (a Cell Command player!). You may need to fix what menu music you have banned if you've banned any in the JUKEBOX menu.


🧬 BALANCE
(Abyss Eye Cell) Armour: Size Max 4 → 3.

(Commander) Cordycep:

Abyss cells with Reflect won't deflect shroom.

MULTI commands will now actually shroom all Abyss cells within command Range. Shroomed Abyss cells won't recognize that another Abyss cell is shroomed, however (so don't report that as a bug).

(Status) Radiation: commands that apply Radiation to a target now also transfer over the user's Radiation Damage value.

This can be considered a buff to ːcdnaːːgdnaːːgdnaːːtdnaː Gammaggot since it comes with a command for this.


♻️ CHANGES
Award:

Attack Of The Clones: Clarified unlock conditions.

Instagib: 3s timer will no longer be reached faster when x3 speed is active.

Abyss Transmissions: Delay between messages 6.875s → 5.625s.

(Commander) Synapse: Your first cell's actions are skipped (unless it's the only cell remaining, so that you can use buttons like Pause Run or a Life), since there's nothing you can do with this cell.

(Mode) GLOOM:

Tiles in a 3x3 grid around spawns will have gloom cleared to start.

Gloom near the edges will no longer appear lighter (looks better if it doesn't).


🛠️ FIXES
(Boss Cell) Antefort: "widdling" → "whittling" in Boss Info.

(Perk) Vaccine: Was deactivating upon using a life when defeated during a mission.

(Award) Attack Of The Clones: Can now trigger if you have 4 cells with matching DNA, but more than 4 cells (where the fifth or sixth cell doesn't match the other's DNA).

Beginner tips (the ones that appear on the SETUP menu) will now automatically be marked read upon your first victory.

For some players, boss cells for defeated bosses were supposed to be automatically discovered upon starting the game after 1.0.5 but it didn't work - now it does.

Conditions that check if Move Max = 0 will now work even when Move Max has went negative (which isn't always obvious since it will always display as 0).

(Abyss Cell) ːcdnaːːgdnaː Eroder, ːcdnaːːcdnaːːgdnaː Sapper, ːcdnaːːcdnaːːcdnaːːgdnaː Sabotager: Will now use their Damage-reduction commands on cells with Damage 1 commands (in other words, they can reduce Damage to 0 now, which was originally intended).

(Commander) Atrax: Eye cells during The Abyss fight will now be marked.

The Abyss: Using a life no longer breaks everything.

Some Right Click / Spacebar settings would let you do things you shouldn't be able to while selecting a gadget target.

Cloaked Abyss Cells:

The last update accidentally allowed moving through Abyss cells, which causes all sorts of problems (from softlocks to crashes).

Since you shouldn't be able to move through them, it's essentially a way to spot them - I'm making it so that attempting to move through them simply uncloaks them. If I don't do this, it honestly just looks like a bug ("why can't I move here???").

Perk:

Pill: Sometimes wasn't unlocking when it should.

Mask: Clarified in the description that it won't trigger when using commands on towers.

Bipod: Was possible to unlock via conditions not described in the stated unlock conditions.

Juicer/Grapple: Some Steam Achievement / in-game unlock confusion between these.

Vaccine:

Using a life to reset the mission would result in mutations affecting Abyss cells instead again.

It was only unlocking upon discovering 30 (unique) mutations, not enduring 30.

(Commander) Devil: Fixed some uh... unlock condition weirdness.

(Commander Cell) ːadnaːːadnaːːadnaːːadnaː Sprintula: Fixed description (said it was faster than the second-fastest cell, which is a silly thing to say considering ːadnaːːadnaːːadnaː Scurrachnid's speed is close).

Records Menu: "Mutations" value fixed (it previously represented the amount discovered).

(Status) Fly:

Various fixes relating to losing Fly while parts of a cell are over an empty space.

Plays a unique sound when this occurs.

Chips:

The ones for "if cell has Armour/Swift/Arc" now also work when a cell gains/loses those statuses mid-mission.

Before/After stats on hover (which you should pay attention to) now factor in chips like the above ones turning off and on.

"DEVS"-type tips would become unread upon re-opening the game.

Filter buttons in the cell evolution button would sometimes be hidden when they shouldn't be.

(Mode) GLOOM: Fixed a case where you could see the command range of an Abyss cell that's obscured by Gloom.

Selecting an unhighlighted part of your active cell would undo all the way back (was supposed to only be for switching to a different cell).

A rare case where black "TELEPORT" text can appear when hovering over a cell with a Teleport command selected.

Updated some achievement descriptions to match their current conditions.

The white trim when selecting a gadget target is now hidden when in submenus.
